classified_failure.frozen_guard: Every Fill marker in one completed publisher/instrument event had to match a Cancel on sequence, order_id, side, price, and size.
classified_failure.direct_observation: The first EQPT request completed download but left at least one Fill marker unmatched under that five-field identity, so replay stopped before feature snapshots were retained.

corrective_interpretation.official_f_last_semantics: F_LAST marks the last normalized record in a single event for a given instrument_id.
corrective_interpretation.official_xnas_execution_semantics: Nasdaq TotalView Order Executed messages normalize to Trade, Fill, and Cancel records; normalized records from one native message share sequence.
corrective_interpretation.what_is_proven: The frozen five-field Fill-to-Cancel identity is not sufficient for the observed EQPT stream as implemented.
corrective_interpretation.what_is_not_proven: The sanitized artifact intentionally contains no raw field values, so it does not identify whether sequence, order_id, side, price, size, multiplicity, or event composition caused the mismatch.
corrective_interpretation.single_next_diagnostic: Before changing replay, count aggregate multiset overlap between Fill and Cancel records under frozen identity projections that omit one or more fields. Persist counts only, never identifiers or market values.
